name: io.github.WardenPoint/wardenpoint-mcp
title: WardenPoint
description: Configure on-call alerting from an AI agent: recipients, groups, escalation policies, on-call schedules and alert routing. Tools are generated from the installation's own OpenAPI description, and no ability can read a secret.

environmentVariables.name: WARDENPOINT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Origin of your WardenPoint installation, without a trailing slash and without /api/v1 — e.g. https://wardenpoint.com. The server reads the API description from it at startup, so the tools always match the version you actually run.

environmentVariables.name: WARDENPOINT_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A company API key from Dashboard → Integrations → API keys. Abilities are chosen when you issue it; read-only is a good place to start. Not needed for --list-tools.

environmentVariables.name: WARDENPOINT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.

environmentVariables.name: WARDENPOINT_ALLOW_INSECURE_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to skip certificate verification. Development stands only — never against production.
